tools.name: search_plugins
tools.description: Search NewVSTs' tracker of recently released audio plugins (VST3/AU/AAX/CLAP) with live prices and intro deals. Filter by keyword, type, format, OS, price. Returns links to newvsts.com.

tools.name: get_deals_ending_soon
tools.description: Active audio plugin intro/launch deals sorted by soonest end date, with sale price, regular price, discount and days left.

tools.name: get_new_releases
tools.description: Audio plugins announced/released in the last N days (default 7 = this week), newest first.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Find similar or alternative plugins to a given plugin (by NewVSTs slug or name), optionally filtered by format/OS/price.

tools.name: get_plugin
tools.description: Full details for one plugin: price and deal end, formats, OS, CLAP/Linux support, features, videos, similar plugins, buy link.
